purpose: Teach: 森下/片岡/水谷/丹羽/高岡/今村/津田/岡村

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、森下氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were younger, you launched that joint venture with Morishita.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity. Warm opening. A memory being offered up, not interrogated. Soft pace, like turning pages in a shared history.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは片岡先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. Father received his guidance from Kataoka-senpai.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Respectful weight on the name. Not defensive — just honoring the chain of influence. Measured, grateful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、水谷氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: And when you were younger, you planned the overseas expansion with Mizutani.
lines.style: Same gentle cadence as the first question. Almost sighing the names. A pattern emerging. Reflective, not probing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは丹羽氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father put Niwa at the center of our communications.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Light emphasis on 「柱に」— the weight of that choice. Not boasting. Acknowledging what was necessary.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、高岡氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: And you set up the accounting structure with Takaoka.
lines.style: The same gentle rhythm continues. Voice slightly lower, as if looking back further. Not a question anymore — a shared knowing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは今村氏を主任として育てられた
lines.en: Yes. Father developed Imamura as our chief manager.
lines.style: Recognition of investment made. A quiet pride in the people he trusted. Steady, grounded. The voice of someone accounting for what endured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、津田氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: And you established the overseas corporation with Tsuda.
lines.style: Voice settling into the deepest reflection. The final piece being placed. Tender, almost a whisper. Looking across a lifetime.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは岡村氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. Father entrusted all our legal affairs to Okamura.
lines.style: Final statement. A closing that isn't sad — it's complete. Breath underneath. The weight of trust given and honor kept. Eyes steady.
